au-0RLy.title: Vegetation: tropical with big green mountains
au-0RLy.summary: A tropical city with big green mountains around it, tall buildings and divided roads in downtown. Cairns feels more urban than other northern Queensland towns.

au-0WyC.title: Road lines: rumble strips as small white stripes
au-0WyC.summary: Edge lines sometimes have rumble strips, small white stripes across the line. New Zealand has them too. The Northern Territory very rarely does.

au-0lXU.title: Vegetation: very tropical coast with palms
au-0lXU.summary: Coastal northern Queensland is very tropical, with palm trees and dark green vegetation.

au-0nBQ.title: Bollard: black and yellow
au-0nBQ.summary: This black-and-yellow bollard is exclusive to Queensland.

au-11H1.title: Signpost: flat instead of round
au-11H1.summary: Some signposts in South Australia and Western Australia are flat. In Western Australia they are usually yellow.

au-17uG.title: Sign: fluorescent border
au-17uG.summary: Road signs with a fluorescent border are almost only found in Queensland.

au-1aB4.title: Property markers: white
au-1aB4.summary: White property markers stand by the road in South Australia.

au-2kHn.title: Sign: thin "Keep Left" with no arrow
au-2kHn.summary: Some Keep Left signs in NSW, Queensland and the Northern Territory use a thinner version with no arrow.

au-3wyr.title: Vegetation: dark red soil, rich green
au-3wyr.summary: Around Darwin: dark red soil, rich green grass and trees, and usually black tree trunks.

au-4Vvd.title: Road: no road lines, tropical north landscape
au-4Vvd.summary: Dorat Road (23) in the Northern Territory has the distinct landscape of the Darwin area and no road lines.

au-5dWF.title: Landscape: flat inland, redder soil inland
au-5dWF.summary: Inland New South Wales is mostly flat, with soil that gets redder further inland and dry pale-green shrubs. In the east and on the borders it has more gum trees, sandier soil and hills.

au-6oil.title: Bus stops: unique design in each state
au-6oil.summary: Every state has its own bus stop design, which is useful in towns. Darwin has concrete shelters. Tasmanian ones mostly show the word metro.

au-7ykV.title: Speed sign: 130 km/h
au-7ykV.summary: A 130 km/h limit only exists in the Northern Territory.

au-8smD.title: Phone numbers: 8 digits with a 2-digit area code
au-8smD.summary: Numbers have 8 digits with a 2-digit area code in front, though not every number shows the code. The area code tells you the state.

au-Aujv.title: Pole: black markings with diagonal numbers
au-Aujv.summary: Black markings on electricity poles between the Gold Coast, Brisbane and Sunshine Coast, often with diagonal numbers.

au-B6K8.title: Pole: three round coils on top
au-B6K8.summary: Pole tops with three circular coils, two at the sides and one vertical at the top, are in Victoria. Other extensions are sometimes added.

au-C2EJ.title: Sign: green town signs with arrows
au-C2EJ.summary: Green signs with white arrows at junctions show nearby towns, sometimes with distance in kilometres. Highways have letter-number names like A2 or C222. In New Zealand, highways are a number on a red crest.

differs.how: Highway numbers on a red crest

au-CAL4.title: Bollard: black-and-white stripes
au-CAL4.summary: Stripy black-and-white bollards are unique to Western Australia.

au-FQEn.title: Pole: thin metal crossbar bent into an L
au-FQEn.summary: Thin metal crossbars bent 90 degrees into an L are common in Tasmania. Normal Australian crossbars are made of wood.

au-Fm8m.title: Landscape: cool climate, green rolling hills
au-Fm8m.summary: Tasmania has a cool, temperate climate, like central-southern Chile or New Zealand, with green rolling hills that look dry in winter shots and gum trees by the road. Parts of Victoria can look similar.

differs.how: Similar cool-climate look, so check other clues
Similar cool-climate look, so check other clues

au-Gni4.title: Google car: rare cars, snorkel antennas
au-Gni4.summary: Dozens of rare cars exist, mostly in nature reserves. Cars with a snorkel (a raised dark pipe on the car) are mostly in NSW and the ACT. Only two snorkel cars are elsewhere, both in Western Australia.

au-I7Ah.title: Landscape: orange rocks in the distance
au-I7Ah.summary: Around the isolated town of Alice Springs, distinct orange rocks appear in the distance or at the end of roads.

au-J0tt.title: Road numbers: starting with letter C
au-J0tt.summary: Roads starting with C are only in Victoria and Tasmania, plus some in South Australia near the Victorian border. These are smaller roads, so Gen 1 or 2 is common.

au-Jbyg.title: Driving side: left
au-Jbyg.summary: Cars drive on the left, as in a handful of other countries.

au-LyHG.title: Fields: sugarcane in the north east
au-LyHG.summary: Sugarcane plantations are very common in northern Queensland thanks to the tropical climate. They go as far south as northern NSW.

au-M5MM.title: Guardrail: ending with black dash on yellow
au-M5MM.summary: A guardrail end with a black dash on a yellow background is almost exclusive to New South Wales and the ACT.

au-NPFj.title: Property markers: dark green
au-NPFj.summary: Dark green property markers stand by the road in Western Australia.

au-NeWE.title: Bollard: shorter reflectors
au-NeWE.summary: Reflectors shorter than usual are most common in Queensland and South Australia. It works best when you see 4 or more in a round, and not in Gen 2.

au-OgUS.title: Pole: white rectangular sticker with blue square
au-OgUS.summary: Poles in Melbourne often have white rectangular stickers with a smaller blue square inside.

au-Oh44.title: Signpost: yellow stickers
au-Oh44.summary: Signposts in the Northern Territory can show yellow stickers.

au-Pbiz.title: Pole: rusty metal with several holes
au-Pbiz.summary: Rusty metal poles with several holes are unique to the Northern Territory, and sometimes in northern WA, near Wyndham.

au-QQZc.title: Signpost: yellow
au-QQZc.summary: Yellow signposts are specific to Western Australia. South Australian bus stops also have yellow posts.

au-RFNj.title: Pole: green painted base
au-RFNj.summary: Poles in Western Australia often have green painted bases, and sometimes a white sticker or a red and white band.

au-S44S.title: Termite mounds: brown spiky formations
au-S44S.summary: Termite mounds are brown spiky formations rising from the ground. They appear in the Northern Territory and rarely in northern WA and Queensland.

au-SH9t.title: Landscape: dry shrubs and wide-crowned gum trees
au-SH9t.summary: Dry land with shrubs and wide-crowned gum trees, with slightly orange sandy soil, between South Australia and Western Australia. The dry area east of Adelaide looks similar but with whiter soil.

au-Snwr.title: Bollard: white, red front reflector, grey back
au-Snwr.summary: White bollards with a red reflector on the front and a grey one on the back. New Zealand's red reflector wraps around the back, while Australia's stops in the middle.

differs.how: Red reflector wraps around to the back

au-T9jc.title: Landscape: isolated hills over flat farmland
au-T9jc.summary: Isolated hills seen from far away over otherwise flat farmland in western Victoria. These are the Grampians.

au-UUqd.title: Pole: concrete poles, mostly in one state
au-UUqd.summary: A 2006 review found 64% of all concrete poles are in Victoria.

au-Uejw.title: Landscape: small range over a flat plain
au-Uejw.summary: A small mountain range, the Stirling Ranges in Western Australia, towers over a flat plain and can be seen from far away.

au-W6mM.title: Sign: red "No Stopping"
au-W6mM.summary: New South Wales is the only state with red No Stopping signs. All others use white.

au-X5tc.title: Hydrant post: white, blue circle, red top
au-X5tc.summary: White hydrant poles with a blue circle and a red section on top are found in Victoria. The designs vary slightly.

au-Y0nT.title: Pole: olive-green possum guards
au-Y0nT.summary: Olive-green possum guards on electricity poles are only found in Tasmania. Possum guards of other colours are found everywhere.

au-YdCf.title: Sign: give way with white border, black text
au-YdCf.summary: Give-way signs have a white border and black text. New Zealand's has red text, and South Africa rarely has give-way signs.

au-ZZKi.title: Traffic lights: white outline or no border
au-ZZKi.summary: Traffic lights with a white outline around the frame are in WA, Queensland, NSW, the ACT and Tasmania. Lights with no border are in the central states.

au-ZgT0.title: Landscape: white soil and pine plantations
au-ZgT0.summary: White soil and large pine plantations around Mount Gambier in South Australia.

au-b54E.title: Plate: design differs by state
au-b54E.summary: Each state uses a different plate design, which you can partly see through the blur.

au-cAlQ.title: Sign: white direction signs
au-cAlQ.summary: White direction signs are only found in Tasmania.

au-cP3a.title: Trees: gum trees with puffy leaf clusters
au-cP3a.summary: Gum trees (eucalyptus) are by far the most common tree. Bark is typically light, with puffy clusters of leaves. Their look changes a lot by region.

au-dHGl.title: Pole: top with coils angled upwards
au-dHGl.summary: Pole tops with coils on the sides angled upwards are unique to Queensland.

au-e2I1.title: Sign: white No Stopping with text
au-e2I1.summary: White No Stopping and No Parking signs that include text are unique to the Australian Capital Territory.

au-ePjU.title: Camera: wire visible on the left side of the car
au-ePjU.summary: A wire can be seen on the left side of the car on most of the Northern Territory part of the Barkly Highway and a small part of the Queensland part.

au-edFk.title: Fire hydrant: red painted top
au-edFk.summary: Fire hydrants with red painted tops are unique to Victoria.

au-fako.title: Pole: trident-like top, 3 insulators
au-fako.summary: A trident-like pole top appears in Western Australia and Victoria. In WA, it often has red insulators and a black crossbar. All three insulators must sit on the crossbar, not the middle one on the pole.

au-hYmO.title: Road: bright orange dirt, short trees
au-hYmO.summary: The Stuart Highway from Alice Springs to Pimba has bright orange dirt, short trees and a blue Gen 4 car. Use the road angle and rumble strips (rarer on the NT side) to tell the states apart.

au-hovh.title: Vegetation: bushes and stubby gums, orange soil
au-hovh.summary: Kangaroo Island has bushes and low, stubby eucalyptus with puffy leaf clusters, orange soil like Western Australia, and only Gen 2 and Gen 4 coverage.

au-iPl5.title: Chevron: white on black, black on yellow
au-iPl5.summary: Chevrons are white on black or black on yellow. New Zealand uses the same colours, but its yellow ones have a thin black border and often a speed limit.

differs.how: Yellow ones have a thin black border and often a speed limit

au-jYdQ.title: Google car: long antenna in Gen 3
au-jYdQ.summary: Gen 3 coverage shows a long antenna on the car.

au-kN13.title: Islands: two remote islands count for streaks
au-kN13.summary: Christmas Island and the Cocos (Keeling) Islands count as part of the country for streaks. Each has its own unique car.

differs.how: Christmas Island, but clicking this country counts
Cocos Islands, but clicking this country counts

au-kYwE.title: Sign: speed limit on a large white rectangle
au-kYwE.summary: Speed signs are a black number in a red circle on a big white rectangle. New Zealand's normally have no white rectangle.

differs.how: No white rectangle behind the sign

au-khBq.title: Pole: Stobie poles in an inland town
au-khBq.summary: South Australian style Stobie poles can sometimes be seen in the NSW town of Broken Hill.

au-lm-12983.title: Sign: stop sign with three big holes
au-lm-12983.summary: In New South Wales, especially Sydney, some stop signs have three big holes.

au-lm-22760.title: Landscape: dense tropical forest
au-lm-22760.summary: Most of this island is dense tropical forest, with unpaved roads of bright white sandy soil, some built-up areas and palms in places.

au-lm-22764.title: Landscape: bright white sand, palms, mowed grass
au-lm-22764.summary: Bright white sand, many palms and mowed grass, much less forested or hilly than the other remote island.

au-lm-22770.title: Soil: reddish-orange in the west
au-lm-22770.summary: Western Australia, especially around Perth, has reddish-orange soil. But many WA areas have light soil, and other states have reddish-orange soil too.

au-lm-269362.title: Road: small paved road, no lines
au-lm-269362.summary: A small paved road with no lines, dead golden grass, driving south or south-east, with an unblurred blue 2024 car.

au-lm-269363.title: Road: unpaved, dead grass
au-lm-269363.summary: An unpaved road with dead golden grass. The north has some trees and pavement without lines, and the grass looks deader the further south you go. Driving south, unblurred blue 2024 car.

au-lm-269622.title: Road: always trees, direction matters
au-lm-269622.summary: An unblurred blue 2024 car, always trees, driving direction and angles very important. The greener it gets, the further east you are. Cloud patterns help but are less reliable.

au-lm-270455.title: Pole: uses both northern and southern poles
au-lm-270455.summary: An unblurred blue 2024 car on a road north of Mildura using poles of the Northern Territory and South Australia. Many exposed blue-car roads nearby give a good feel.

au-lm-271650.title: Road: unpaved, grass only, no clouds
au-lm-271650.summary: Unpaved road, black 2024 car, driving north and south, almost only grass and no clouds.

au-lm-283.title: Pole: three Tasmanian pole signs
au-lm-283.summary: Three signs for poles in Tasmania: olive-green possum guards, a crossbar bent 90 degrees, and a unique lamp arm.

au-lm-304727.title: Google car: black 2023 car, half exposed
au-lm-304727.summary: A black 2023 car, 50% exposed, with something odd on the car (see the third picture) and sometimes grey gravel by the road.

au-lm-304886.title: Road: exposed black car, cloudy, red ridge
au-lm-304886.summary: A black 2023 car, 90% exposed, cloudy, with a red ridge to the north, driving west.

au-lm-361182.title: Landscape: very cloudy, unpaved red soil
au-lm-361182.summary: An unblurred blue 2024 car, very cloudy, unpaved red soil. It looks very unique.

au-lm-369.title: Road lines: reflector in an edge-line gap
au-lm-369.summary: A gap with a reflector in the edge line means the ACT. South Australia can have gaps but a reflector in the gap is very rare there.

au-lm-372.title: Pole: grey thin plate with numbers
au-lm-372.summary: A grey, long thin plate with numbers, sometimes with a small blue or other coloured circle, means Queensland outside the south-east, where a different marking is used.

au-lm-395223.title: Vegetation: table ridge north, low bushes
au-lm-395223.summary: A table-shaped ridge to the north, red 2023 car, low to very low bushes and sometimes trees, driving west. A short stretch has an exposed blue 2024 car.

au-lm-395224.title: Landscape: blue 2024 car, unpaved
au-lm-395224.summary: A blue 2024 car, unpaved road, sandy grey soil and trees.

au-lm-395225.title: Vegetation: sparse arid plants, blue 2023 car
au-lm-395225.summary: Sparse arid vegetation, blue 2023 car, wide unpaved road, driving east.

au-lm-395226.title: Landscape: red 2025 car can look black, unpaved
au-lm-395226.summary: A red 2025 car that can look black, unpaved road, soil that can be whitish-red or grey, driving counterclockwise.

au-lm-396016.title: Vegetation: flat with almost no plants
au-lm-396016.summary: Black 2024 car, very flat, almost no vegetation, paved with red soil around, driving north.

au-lm-396221.title: Vegetation: outback plants, red soil
au-lm-396221.summary: Red 2024 car driving south through outback vegetation with red soil around.

au-lm-442759.title: Road: pipeline along the road, red road
au-lm-442759.summary: A pipeline beside the road (always to the north or east), about 60% red road, driving north or north-west, white or black cars and sometimes a blue one at sunset.

au-lm-444139.title: Road: pipeline, white or black car
au-lm-444139.summary: A pipeline beside the road, white and black cars, copyright 2022-2024, driving south except in two small areas.

au-lm-444157.title: Landscape: red 2025 car, pipe to south or west
au-lm-444157.summary: A red 2025 car, a pipe running south or west, and red soil.

au-lm-446070.title: Vegetation: white 2023 car, almost no plants
au-lm-446070.summary: White 2023 car, grid-pattern clouds, driving south and almost no vegetation.

au-lm-446073.title: Vegetation: blue 2019 car, copyright often 2022
au-lm-446073.summary: A blue 2019 car, copyright often 2022, sometimes no vegetation and sometimes small bushes or trees.

au-lm-446675.title: Vegetation: lush green, hilly, sunset
au-lm-446675.summary: A white 2023 car, lush green plants, hilly land and a sunset.

au-lm-447108.title: Road: red 2025 car, pipe north
au-lm-447108.summary: A red 2025 car with a pipe to the north. The town area has more clouds.

au-lm-447110.title: Road: black 2023 car, sunset
au-lm-447110.summary: A black 2023 car with a sunset.

au-lm-447227.title: Landscape: exposed white car, flat land
au-lm-447227.summary: An unblurred white 2024 car, flat land, sometimes hills in the distance, very green or very red. The part in South Australia has road lines.

au-lm-447358.title: Road: exposed red 2024 car
au-lm-447358.summary: An unblurred red 2024 car with brown material on the road.

au-lm-447412.title: Road: black 2023 car, small road
au-lm-447412.summary: A black 2023 car on a small road.

au-lm-447506.title: Vegetation: overcast, black 2023 car
au-lm-447506.summary: A black 2023 car, overcast or many clouds, not driving west. Trees grow less densely in the east and the land is more open.

au-lm-449144.title: Road: very black road, no edge lines
au-lm-449144.summary: A black 2023 car, a very black road with no edge lines, a sunny day with clouds, driving north or north-west.

au-lm-449145.title: Road: black 2023 car, driving west
au-lm-449145.summary: A black 2023 car, driving west (important) and gridded clouds.

au-lm-449393.title: Road: blue 2022 car, paved
au-lm-449393.summary: A blue 2022 car on a paved road, with a small red 2025 stretch around a beach.

au-lm-455384.title: Road: pipe, blue car west and red car east
au-lm-455384.summary: A pipe along the road. The blue 2025 car is west of one town, the red 2025 car is east of it.

au-lm-465363.title: Road: red 2023 car often exposed, sunset
au-lm-465363.summary: A red 2023 car, often unblurred, with a sunset and outback scenery.

au-lm-468788.title: Road: dark blue 2024 car, hilly, no edge lines
au-lm-468788.summary: Dark blue 2024 car, hilly land, no edge lines, paved, overcast or many clouds.

au-lm-469022.title: Road: black 2023 car off-roads
au-lm-469022.summary: A black 2023 car on off-roads in Queensland. The Northern Territory has black 2023 off-roads too, but they look different.

au-lm-469147.title: Road: red 2024 car, overcast, paved
au-lm-469147.summary: A red 2024 car (unblurred), overcast sky, paved road.

au-lm-469202.title: Road: dark blue 2024 car, sunset, can be hilly
au-lm-469202.summary: A dark blue 2024 car, sunset, can be hilly, with less pavement in the southern part.

au-lm-470105.summary: A dark blue 2024 car, a sunset in the western part and a ridge to the south, at a famous mountain.

au-lm-470106.title: Road: black 2023 car, black pavement, sunset

au-lm-470107.summary: A black 2023 car driving east at sunset, with full road lines and mixed pavement colours (black, grey, striped, reddish).

au-lm-473682.summary: A black 2023 car, new pavement, overcast and driving north.

au-lm-476497.summary: A dark blue 2024 car, red soil with lush green grass, sunset and driving east.

au-lm-477533.summary: A dark blue 2024 car with flowers everywhere, no pavement, puffy clouds turning overcast, driving south.

au-lm-480623.summary: A black 2023 car with a sunset, driving east or south-east.

au-lm-483447.summary: A white 2025 car, full road lines or a bike road, and puffy clouds.

au-lm-483890.summary: A red 2023 car on a straight 150 km road, with a sunset to the west and savanna land.

au-lm-488894.title: Road: dark blue 2024 car, no lines
au-lm-488894.summary: A dark blue 2024 car on off-road or small paved roads with no lines, a north-west driving angle, sunset and clouds. More clouds means further south.

au-lm-488896.summary: An unblurred white 2024 car, sunset, dead land and a railway beside the road, with outer stripes of South Australia.

au-lm-488898.summary: An unblurred white 2024 car, striped clouds and a railway.

au-lm-491530.summary: An unblurred blue 2024 car, dramatic clouds, some sunset, golden fields and mallee (low gum scrub).

au-lm-492200.summary: A black 2023 car driving west, cracks around the sun and no clouds.

au-lm-498624.summary: A red 2025 car, dry, hilly forest.

au-lm-501459.summary: A red 2025 car driving north with swoosh-shaped or striped clouds.

au-lm-503912.summary: A black 2025 car, very foggy coverage, many red bollards and white bollards with black stripes.

au-lm-520731.summary: A red 2024 car, wet road and overcast skies.

au-lm-534888.summary: A black 2024 car, very dry, no road lines, driving east and sometimes very thin.

au-lm-534890.summary: A black 2025 car, desert, unpaved road, a layer of wavy clouds and rare trees.

au-lm-541757.summary: A red 2025 car driving north or west with puffy clouds around or in the distance.

au-lm-541758.summary: An unblurred blue 2025 car, overcast, 90% driving north.

au-lm-542121.summary: A red 2025 car driving west into the sunset. The western part is unpaved with no road lines.

au-lm-543008.summary: A white 2024 car, dry land with red sand and some trees. One town has middle road lines and red roads, the other has no road lines. No clouds.

au-lm-544417.title: Landscape: red 2025 car, red soil with gravel
au-lm-544417.summary: A red 2025 car, red unpaved soil with gravel and puffy clouds. It can fool you into guessing Western Australia.

au-lm-544419.title: Landscape: red 2025 car, red gravel soil
au-lm-544419.summary: A red 2025 car, red soil with gravel, unpaved, some clouds and a small part with a thin pipe to the west.

au-lm-545174.summary: A white 2025 car, sunset, 90% no edge lines and a slightly red road.

au-lm-545250.title: Road: black 2023 car, cracks in the road
au-lm-545250.summary: A black 2023 car, looks like Alice Springs, and cracks in the road, which are rare in Australia overall.

au-lm-555900.summary: A black 2025 car, swoosh-shaped overcast and random driving direction.

au-lm-557644.summary: A dark blue 2024 car, sunny with no clouds, driving south, full road lines and sometimes flowers around.

au-lm-600686.title: Landscape: red 2025 car, unpaved, sunny
au-lm-600686.summary: A red 2025 car, unpaved, very sunny with no clouds, hills around or in the distance, sometimes flat-topped.

au-lm-600688.title: Road: dark blue 2024 car, driving west
au-lm-600688.summary: A dark blue 2024 car driving west, sheep-shaped clouds in the western part and lots of violet flowers by the road.

au-lm-600689.title: Road: red 2025 car, unpaved, swoosh clouds
au-lm-600689.summary: A red 2025 car, unpaved or no road lines, swoosh-shaped clouds and random driving direction.

au-lm-601315.title: Road: dark blue 2025 car, driving east
au-lm-601315.summary: A dark blue 2025 car (rare in South Australia), driving east through dry, dead land.

au-lm-608127.title: Road: black 2025 car, 90% driving north, desert
au-lm-608127.summary: A black 2025 car, 90% driving north, desert and sunny.

au-lm-608128.title: Vegetation: black 2025 car, off-roads
au-lm-608128.summary: A black 2025 car on off-roads, a very simple region that is extremely hard to learn in detail. It can have trees or desert.

au-lm-610747.title: Road: white 2024 car, sunset west, no lines
au-lm-610747.summary: A white 2024 car, sunset in the western part, very sunny with no clouds, no road lines and 50% bike road.

au-lm-612745.title: Road: red 2025 car, swoosh clouds, full lines
au-lm-612745.summary: A red 2025 car, swoosh clouds, full road lines and driving north.

au-lm-612746.title: Road: red 2025 car, almost overcast
au-lm-612746.summary: A red 2025 car, almost overcast, 90% driving west and 99% edge lines with stripes (see the fourth picture).

au-lm-613334.title: Landscape: blue exposed 2025 car
au-lm-613334.summary: An unblurred blue 2025 car in a strange-looking national park, sometimes with red soil.

au-lm-613725.title: Road: white 2025 car, driving south, green grass
au-lm-613725.summary: A white 2025 car driving south with swoosh-ish clouds (sometimes few), the sun always behind clouds and very green grass.

au-lm-614083.title: Landscape: white 2025 car, odd driving direction
au-lm-614083.summary: A white 2025 car with odd driving direction. Mountains are rarely visible and far away. It can look like another nearby road, which has closer hills. The road varies between paved, thin and unpaved.

au-lm-617872.title: Road: red 2024 car, unpaved, puffy clouds
au-lm-617872.summary: A red 2024 car, unpaved and puffy clouds.

au-lm-621569.title: Road: black 2025 car, driving south
au-lm-621569.summary: A black 2025 car driving south with swoosh clouds.

au-lm-621606.title: Road: black 2025 car, no lines, sunset
au-lm-621606.summary: A black 2025 car, paved road with no road lines, sunset and a visible moon.

au-lm-621743.title: Road: white 2025 car, sheep clouds, driving west
au-lm-621743.summary: A white 2025 car, sheep-shaped clouds, driving west and full road lines.

au-lm-621744.title: Road: white 2025 car, bike lanes, no lines
au-lm-621744.summary: A white 2025 car, bike lanes and no road lines. The car coverage starts at a particular town.

au-lm-621745.title: Road: black 2023 car, thin road, driving south
au-lm-621745.summary: A black 2023 car on a thin road driving south, with only middle lines or none, sometimes a bike road and no clouds.

au-lm-621746.title: Road: black 2023 car, driving north, bike lane
au-lm-621746.summary: A black 2023 car driving north with a bike lane and no clouds.

au-lm-621861.title: Road: black 2024 car, sheep clouds, no lines
au-lm-621861.summary: A black 2024 car, sheep-shaped clouds, driving south-west and 99% no road lines.

au-lm-622002.title: Road: exposed blue 2025 car
au-lm-622002.summary: An unblurred blue 2025 car, driving away from the town, one road with middle lines and a white road with none, paved.

au-lm-622183.title: Road: blue 2024 car, sunny
au-lm-622183.summary: A blue 2024 car, sunny, unpaved or small road with no road lines.

au-lm-622184.title: Road: white 2024 car, wild green elevated area
au-lm-622184.summary: A white 2024 car with a wild area and green elevated land that looks wet.

au-lm-637094.title: Road: white 2025 car, off-road, overcast
au-lm-637094.summary: A white 2025 car on an off-road or small road, with cloudy to overcast skies.

au-lm-637095.title: Pole: A6-type poles, red road, railway, moon
au-lm-637095.summary: Different cars, A6-type poles, sometimes red road, a railway and a visible moon.

au-lm-642109.title: Road: white 2026 car, full lines
au-lm-642109.summary: A white 2026 car, random driving direction and 99% full road lines.

au-lm-689381.title: Road: grey 2025 car, driving south, no lines
au-lm-689381.summary: A grey 2025 car driving south with some clouds and no road lines.

au-lm-689633.title: Road: grey 2025 car, off-road, 90% red, no lines
au-lm-689633.summary: A grey 2025 car on off-road or tiny road with no lines, 90% red, driving west or north and sunny.

au-lm-714739.title: Road: grey 2025 car, small road, driving west
au-lm-714739.summary: A grey 2025 car driving west on a small road with no lines. It is overcast in the west and some clouds in the east.

au-lm-714773.title: Road: white 2025 car, hazy sky
au-lm-714773.summary: A white 2025 car, usually driving south, with a hazy sky and clouds.

au-lm-714890.title: Road: white 2026 car, full lines, some clouds
au-lm-714890.summary: A white 2026 car, random driving direction, full road lines and some clouds. It can be a 50-50 with a similar road.

au-lm-714891.title: Road: dark blue 2024 car, driving east, low sun
au-lm-714891.summary: A dark blue 2024 car driving east with a low sun and flat-topped clouds.

au-lm-715041.title: Road: white 2025 car, driving west, blue sky
au-lm-715041.summary: A white 2025 car driving west under a blue sky.

au-lm-715042.title: Landscape: white 2026 car, no edge lines
au-lm-715042.summary: A white 2026 car, random driving direction and no edge lines.

au-lm-722385.title: Camera: sun with splodges around it
au-lm-722385.summary: A sun with splodges around it can be seen on one road in Western Australia, between Newman and Doolgunna.

au-lm-722398.title: Plate: very slim, like Swiss front plates
au-lm-722398.summary: Very slim plates, like Swiss front plates, are found in Victoria and New South Wales. In Victoria you usually see two blue blocks of text. In NSW they look plain.

au-lm-722400.title: Plate: blue taxi plates
au-lm-722400.summary: Blue plates on taxis are found only in New South Wales.

au-lm-722401.title: Pole: octagonal
au-lm-722401.summary: Octagonal poles are found mostly in and around Sydney.

au-lm-722402.title: Pole tag: yellow stickers forming a T
au-lm-722402.summary: Rectangular yellow stickers that usually form a T are exclusive to New South Wales.

au-lm-722403.title: Pole tag: vertical with white ends
au-lm-722403.summary: In NSW, plain vertical pole tags are south and west of Sydney. If the tags have white ends on both sides, you are not close to Sydney.

au-lm-722405.title: Roads: red-tinted road in the north east
au-lm-722405.summary: In Queensland, red-tinted roads are mostly around Charters Towers (especially with more trees), and also on one road nearby and further north. There may be exceptions.

au-lm-722406.title: Trees: odd tree with thin vine-like leaves
au-lm-722406.summary: Excoecaria parvifolia is a strange tree with thin, vine-like growths as leaves. It is mostly around the new 2025 white-car coverage in northern Queensland.

au-lm-722407.title: Pole tag: only horizontal tags
au-lm-722407.summary: In NSW, pole tags that are purely horizontal, with no vertical one on the same pole, are not found around Sydney.

au-lm-722409.title: Pole tag: codes with one or two letters
au-lm-722409.summary: In the triangle between Sydney, Newcastle and Scone, NSW pole tags almost always have one or two letters in their codes.

au-lm-722410.title: Pole: round concrete with rows of dots
au-lm-722410.summary: Round concrete poles with dots going up them are found in New South Wales.

au-lm-722411.title: Pole top: upside-down A shape
au-lm-722411.summary: This pole top, an upside-down A, is found in South Australia (on a Stobie pole) and New South Wales (on a round pole).

au-lm-722413.title: Pole: green dot
au-lm-722413.summary: A green dot on poles is sometimes found in New South Wales.

au-lm-722414.title: Pole: hanging insulators
au-lm-722414.summary: Poles with hanging insulators are found in Queensland and New South Wales.

au-lm-722416.title: Palms: fan palm in the north east
au-lm-722416.summary: The Queensland fan palm grows only in north-eastern Queensland, especially around Cairns.

au-lm-722417.title: Pole tag: blue sticker and vertical steel tag
au-lm-722417.summary: Poles with a blue sticker and a vertical steel tag are found in Queensland, north of Rockhampton.

au-lm-722418.title: Palms: sand palm in the far north
au-lm-722418.summary: The sand palm grows only in the north of the Northern Territory, from the Fitzmaurice River to Cape Arnhem and inland as far as Katherine.

au-lm-722430.title: Trees: bottle trees planted in town
au-lm-722430.summary: Bottle trees grow across Queensland but are planted everywhere in the city of Roma.

au-lm-730209.title: Road: red 2024 car, green grass on red sand
au-lm-730209.summary: A red 2024 car, green grass on red sand, driving north on a thin road with no road lines.

au-lm-733309.title: Road: white 2026 car, driving north, full lines
au-lm-733309.summary: A white 2026 car driving north with full road lines.

au-lm-7409.title: Bus stop: concrete shelter
au-lm-7409.summary: Darwin uses concrete shelters as bus stops.

au-lm-7410.title: Bus stop: horizontal pole with information
au-lm-7410.summary: In Western Australia, bus stops are marked by horizontal poles carrying information.

au-lm-7411.title: Bus stop: orange post, sign over the top
au-lm-7411.summary: In South Australia, bus stops have an orange signpost with a sign extending over the top of it.

au-lm-7412.title: Bus stop: mostly say "Metro"
au-lm-7412.summary: Tasmanian bus stops come in several versions, but most say Metro.

au-lm-7413.title: Bus stop: white, orange, black, grey, white
au-lm-7413.summary: Victorian bus stops have a white-orange-black-grey-white colour scheme.

au-lm-7414.title: Bus stop: unique design in the capital territory
au-lm-7414.summary: The capital territory has its own bus stop design, found nowhere else.

au-lm-7415.title: Bus stop: blue with white B or bent post
au-lm-7415.summary: New South Wales has two bus stop designs: a blue one with a white B in a circle, and one where the signpost bends over the sign.

au-lm-7416.title: Bus stop: yellow signpost bending over the sign
au-lm-7416.summary: Queensland bus stops have a yellow signpost that bends over the actual sign.

au-lm-7417.title: Plate: dark red letters
au-lm-7417.summary: Queensland plates have dark red letters that show through the blur. Northern Territory plates are similar with lighter red. An older green version also exists.

au-lm-7418.title: Plate: yellow plates
au-lm-7418.summary: Yellow plates are occasionally found in New South Wales, though most plates are white. Older Western Australian plates are yellow too, but very rare.

au-lm-7419.title: Plate: bright red letters
au-lm-7419.summary: Northern Territory plates have bright red lettering that shines through the blur. Queensland plates are similar but darker.

au-lm-7420.title: Plate: blue letters and thin blue top stripe
au-lm-7420.summary: Western Australian plates have blue letters and a thin blue stripe at the top, sometimes visible through the blur.

au-lm-7421.title: Plate: small triangle at the top
au-lm-7421.summary: Victorian plates have a small triangle at the top, sometimes visible through the blur.

au-lm-7446.title: Speed sign: 25 km/h school zone
au-lm-7446.summary: South Australia is the only state with a 25 km/h speed limit in school zones.

au-lm-7462.title: Coverage: only Gen 1, all copyright 2021
au-lm-7462.summary: Jervis Bay only has Gen 1 coverage, all with 2021 copyright.

au-lm-7483.title: Kerbs: sloped, gradually down to the road
au-lm-7483.summary: Perth has sloped kerbs that decline gradually to the road. Other cities have kerbs that drop 90 degrees.

au-lm-7487.title: Camera: entire leaf in the Gen 2 halo
au-lm-7487.summary: In much Gen 2 around Morwell and Traralgon in eastern Victoria, a whole leaf is visible on the Gen 2 edge. A half leaf is seen in the east of South Australia.

au-lm-7488.title: Camera: twig in the Gen 2 halo
au-lm-7488.summary: In Gen 2 in an area of eastern NSW, a twig is visible in the Gen 2 halo.

au-lm-7493.title: Google car: open boot
au-lm-7493.summary: In one Western Australian town, the driver left the car boot open while covering it, which makes a unique look.

au-lm-7494.title: Coverage: smoke from a bushfire
au-lm-7494.summary: Around the Devils Marbles, north of Davenport in the Northern Territory, smoke from a bushfire is visible.

au-lm-89007.title: Road: dead golden grass, white car
au-lm-89007.summary: Dead golden grass, a white car from 2024 coverage, driving north-west.

au-lm-89008.title: Road: very low bushes, driving east or west
au-lm-89008.summary: Very low bushes in a protected wilderness area, driving east or west.

au-lm-89009.title: Vegetation: very green trees, short-antenna car
au-lm-89009.summary: Very green vegetation and trees, with a car with a short antenna that is not always visible. This is in a national park.

au-lm-89010.title: Road: off-road through hills, dark blue car
au-lm-89010.summary: Off-road through hilly land with a dark blue 2024 car, grey and red soil, driving north.

au-lm-89011.title: Road: small paved road, trees north
au-lm-89011.summary: A small paved road with green trees in the north and very flat dead grass in the south, driving south.

au-lm-89012.title: Road: dead grass, red soil, bushes
au-lm-89012.summary: Driving south in a blue 2019 car, with dead grass, red soil and bushes.

au-lm-89015.title: Google car: long antenna Gen 3, red soil
au-lm-89015.summary: Driving south in clear skies, Gen 3 with a long antenna, red soil, bushes and trees.

au-lm-89016.title: Road: unpaved, grass only, cloudy
au-lm-89016.summary: Unpaved road, black 2024 car, driving north, almost only grass and cloudy skies.

au-lm-89017.title: Road: no plants, flat red desert, white 2023 car
au-lm-89017.summary: No vegetation, flat red desert (sometimes hills), a paved and an unpaved road that can look similar, mostly driving south, white 2023 car.

au-lm-89020.title: Road: huge unpaved road, red sand, dark blue car
au-lm-89020.summary: A huge unpaved road with red sand, a dark blue 2024 car, driving south-east and almost no hills.

au-lxhc.title: Landscape: lush green or golden fields
au-lxhc.summary: A band of lush green or golden fields from the south of the Yorke Peninsula to Echuca. The South Australian side is drier with wide-crowned gums. The Victorian side has taller, leafier trees.

au-mrYL.title: Google car: Gen 2 not in this territory
au-mrYL.summary: Gen 2 coverage cannot be found in the Northern Territory, which helps in 50-50s.

au-nMfy.title: Road lines: all yellow near a mountain
au-nMfy.summary: All-yellow road lines near Mount Kosciuszko, plus a unique white truck with a snorkel (raised pipe) and cab guard. Other alpine areas in Victoria and NSW can also have yellow lines.

au-nO8C.title: Street sign: Brisbane council design
au-nO8C.summary: This street sign design is unique to the Brisbane City Council.

au-pAMj.title: Plants: brush plants in the west
au-pAMj.summary: These brush plants are common in Western Australia.

au-tILb.title: Pole: round blue stickers
au-tILb.summary: Round blue stickers are on Queensland poles. The same sticker can be a different colour or almost fully faded.

au-tslH.title: Road lines: triple broken centre lines
au-tslH.summary: The Sturt Highway from Wentworth to Wagga Wagga can have triple broken centre lines. Other major NSW roads, such as the Gwydir Highway, have them too, but less often.

au-ttAJ.title: Vegetation: flat, grey, very low plants
au-ttAJ.summary: The Nullarbor Highway (Latin for no tree) is flat, grey and has very low vegetation. Use the road angle or road lines to tell the WA side from the SA side.

au-uo2W.title: Bollard: brown paint at the bottom
au-uo2W.summary: Bollards with a big brown bottom are most common in Western Australia. Small brown bottoms can appear elsewhere.

au-vjrK.title: Street sign: Gold Coast council design
au-vjrK.summary: This street sign design is unique to the Gold Coast City Council.

au-vw3g.title: Landscape: red soil, Gen 2 camera, rocky hills
au-vw3g.summary: Red soil, a Gen 2 camera and rocky hills point to the area around Tom Price.

au-xuhU.title: Pole: steel-and-concrete Stobie pole
au-xuhU.summary: The Stobie pole, made of steel and concrete, is specific to South Australia, with unique tops (trident or a rotated letter E). A few thousand are in other states, most in Tasmania.

au-yxkv.title: Road lines: almost always white
au-yxkv.summary: Road lines are almost all white, with rare exceptions in alpine areas. Yellow edge or centre lines mean South Africa or New Zealand instead, although New Zealand can have all-white lines too.

au-zB6F.title: Street sign: City of Sydney design
au-zB6F.summary: This street sign design is unique to the City of Sydney.
